text_block_list.text:
Worried about studying French...
I consulted Mei Satake, and she took me to
a play performed entirely in French on her day off.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
If you want to learn a language,
it's best to get your ears used to everyday conversations.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I did the exact same thing with musicals and
operas back when I was studying Japanese.
Focusing hard while listening really accelerated the results!
choice_data_list: Still, will they be able to understand right away...?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Rest easy!
I've been fully prepared ever since you first came to me for advice!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I've summarized the main plot――
and compiled the essential keywords that appear in the dialogue.
As long as you catch these, you'll be set!
choice_data_list: You went through all that trouble just for this...?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
It's just in my nature to root for those who give it their all.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
We still have time before the curtain rises.
Please look this over in the lobby!

Mei Satake went out of her way to provide passionate
guidance, even giving up her day off.
I couldn't be more grateful for her kindness.
choice_data_list: (I'm going to give it my all and learn everything I can!)

text_block_list.text: (Wooo... Clap clap clap)

The curtain fell. Thanks to the handouts she gave me,
I was able to fully enjoy the show,
and I gave the actors a hearty round of applause――

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Magnifique!
Bravoooooooooooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: The acting! The direction! The music! Passion from the creators overflowed from every single part!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
A true tidal wave of emotion!
Look! Even my skin's giving a standing ovation!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Right, let's go! To the souvenir shop!
We must commemorate this emotional moment!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Splendid!!
To incorporate so many motifs from the show...
They truly understand the fan's heart!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Fine craftsmanship...!
There's no reason not to buy this!
Her praise and excitement knew no bounds――

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Whew…… That was a truly meaningful day……!
All thanks to being exposed to so many wonderful things!
choice_data_list: You really know how to give a compliment, Ms. Satake.

text_block_list.text:
I shared what I thought after watching all day.
Being praised like that must feel wonderful for them,
and I felt inspired to follow their example...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please feel free to copy me!
Praise should always be given at full power!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Praise makes the soul shine bright!
Both for the one giving it, and the one receiving it!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
The first time I felt it was at the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, too.
After being captivated by the race, I saw another storm brewing...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"That was the best run I've ever seen!"
"My lady! I'll love you for the rest of my life!"

text_block_list.name: Competitor
text_block_list.text:
"……! Thank you, thank you so much!
Everyone, thank you for showing me so much love……!!"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Praise brings happiness to both sides!
So I decided that whenever I compliment someone,
I'll give it everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Truly, with my whole heart and soul—

text_block_list.name: Passing Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Whoooa!?!?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Ah, haha... sorry.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: I guess it's my habit of praising with my whole heart and soul... My reactions end up way too dramatic. ...Ouch.

text_block_list.name: Passing Dog
text_block_list.text: Whimper...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: I-It wasn't the doggie's fault at all! If anything, sorry for startling you!
Having taken a spectacular tumble, she looked quite embarrassed... which made for a rather heartwarming sight.
